SELECT inventory.store_id, AVG(rental_payments.total_amount) AS avg_payment_amount_per_rental, AVG(rental_payments.payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental
FROM (
  SELECT rental.rental_id, inventory.store_id, SUM(payment.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
  FROM payment
  JOIN rental ON rental.rental_id = payment.rental_id
  JOIN inventory ON inventory.inventory_id = rental.inventory_id
  WHERE payment.amount >= 4.99
  GROUP BY rental.rental_id, inventory.store_id
) AS rental_payments
GROUP BY inventory.store_id;
